pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, dark-pigmented regions with highly irregular, dendritic or 'star-burst' margins. The geometry is characterized by sharp edge gradients and jagged extensions into the surrounding light corridors.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light-colored pathways forming a grid-like topology. Junction nodes consist of 3-way and 4-way intersections. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the mid-flank but narrows as it approaches the ventral region.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Mane is visible along the dorsal neck as a low-amplitude, high-frequency fringe of short, stiff hairs creating a finely jagged 1D silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of numerous small, raised, circular nodules and skin protuberances clustered primarily on the lower flank and ventral neck, creating a distinct lumpy texture.
